candidate_table_note: 1,320 PDB entries: antibody/nanobody keyword hits released after 2024-09-09 (latest of AF3, Chai-1, ESM3, IgFold, RFAA), one distinct heavy V domain (IMGT/ANARCI screen), >10% normalized Levenshtein distance from train+val heavy chains, full-length IMGT 1-128. This pipeline re-derives everything from the original mmCIF/FASTA and does not reuse the IMGT sequences from that table.
model_selection: lowest pdbx_PDB_model_num present for the chain
altloc_rule: residue-level: shared atoms (blank altloc) plus one altloc label; choose label with most backbone atoms having occupancy>0, then highest summed backbone occupancy, then alphabetical
representative_rule: per PDB entry and heavy-domain sequence: copy with most complete backbone atoms, ties broken by label_asym_id order
formal_set_requires: mapping_status ok for every residue with coordinates
full submitted sequence available and consistent between FASTA and mmCIF
domain_type_rule: VHH if the heavy entity description mentions nanobody/VHH/sybody/single-domain antibody; VH if no such annotation and a light-chain V domain (AbNumber K/L) exists in the same entry; otherwise unknown. AbNumber H type alone is not treated as VHH evidence.

not_restricted.experimental_method: not restricted (all inputs are experimental PDB entries; method recorded)
not_restricted.structural_completeness_threshold: not restricted (missing residues/atoms are annotated, not filtered)
